name: InteriorCaptureRig — AI render camera
purpose: Auto-position a camera INSIDE a real room of the unit GLB, frame the placed furniture + columns, and capture one screenshot to send to the img2img backend.
problem_it_solves: The ROOM*.glb files are a whole flat with no per-room tags. Some GLBs also contain a long building strip (e.g. ROOM2 is ~79m deep) and span two storeys (~4.5m tall). Naive centering put the camera outside, through walls, or near the ceiling.

steps.name: Scale setup
steps.eyeHeight: floor (box.min.y) + 1.45m — human standing height, independent of the GLB's 4.5m height
steps.roomReach: min(12m, max(W,D)) — caps the 'ray escaped' distance to a realistic room scale so a 79m strip doesn't inflate the room size

steps.name: Collect collision meshes
steps.detail: All visible meshes (walls, columns, doors, slab) — NOT furniture (too small, would give false 'enclosed' reads)

steps.name: Sample grid of candidate standpoints
steps.gridZ: max(7, min(40, round(D/1.5))) — denser along the long axis so a strip's rooms aren't skipped
steps.perPoint: cast 8 horizontal rays; measure distance to nearest wall in each direction

steps.name: Probe metrics per point
steps.enclosedCount: of 8 rays, how many hit a wall within roomReach*0.8 (a real room hits on most sides)
steps.minHitDist: nearest wall — penalised if jammed against a wall/column
steps.avgDist: average wall distance ≈ room radius (size proxy)
steps.openCentroid: average of all ray directions weighted by distance — points toward the BULK of open room volume (used to look INTO the room, not down one wall)

steps.name: Pick best standpoint
steps.score: enclosedCount*10 + avgDist*2 + min(minHitDist, 2) — favours the biggest enclosed room (usually the living room)

ifFurnitureNearby.condition: pieces within roomRadius*1.15 of the standpoint
ifFurnitureNearby.lookAt: centroid of those furniture pieces, y = eye - H*0.10
ifFurnitureNearby.eyePoint: stand BACK from the cluster (opposite direction) by min(roomRadius*0.85, roomReach*0.5) so furniture is in front of the lens

elseNoFurniture.lookAt: standpoint + openCentroid * lookDist (look into the open volume)
elseNoFurniture.eyePoint: standpoint offset slightly against openCentroid for depth

steps.name: Lens
steps.fov: roomRadius < 3 ? 72 (tight bedroom) : roomRadius < 5 ? 62 : 54 (large living room) — wider for small rooms, longer for big ones to reduce distortion

steps.name: Capture
steps.detail: Render after 2 frames (textures/AO settled), downscale canvas to max edge 768px, encode JPEG @0.85 to keep the img2img payload under Cloudflare's request-size limit (avoids HTTP 413).

downstream.strength: 0.3 — LOW so the model traces the screenshot (keeps columns/furniture/layout) and only repaints surfaces; high values make it invent a new room
